summary.en: US futures trade mixed ahead of Friday's open as oil prices climb on geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and Iran, while AI-driven mega-cap gains offset broader concerns about inflation sticky bits. PPI data due later this week could push Fed rate cut odds higher or lower depending on print.
summary.zh: 上周五开盘前美股期货分化，受中东和伊朗地缘政治紧张局势推动油价上涨，AI 驱动的大型科技股收益抵消了对通胀粘性的担忧。本周稍后发布的 PPI 数据将根据实际数值推高或压低美联储降息预期。

title.en: Oil Climbs on Iran's Hormuz Standoff – What to Watch Today
title.zh: 油价上涨：伊朗霍尔木兹海峡紧张局势升级

impact.en: Elevated oil prices test Fed's inflation buffer and could trigger mean reversion in growth stocks. If WTI breaches key resistance, energy sector outperformance may drag broader market higher despite yield concerns.
impact.zh: 油价高企考验美联储通胀缓冲，可能引发成长股均值回归。如果 WTI 突破关键阻力位，尽管存在收益率担忧，能源板块的出色表现仍可能拖累大盘更高。

macroRisk.en: Yes - High oil prices increase inflation expectations, pressuring Fed rate cut probabilities and impacting real asset valuations including equities.
macroRisk.zh: 是——高油价推升通胀预期，打压美联储降息概率，影响包括股票在内的实物资产估值。

title.en: AI Stocks Rally as Mega-Caps Lead Index Gains
title.zh: AI 板块领涨：大型科技股引领指数上涨

impact.en: NVIDIA partnerships with sovereign funds and strong enterprise AI adoption continue to support chip designers. Cloud infrastructure demand remains robust despite mixed futures.
impact.zh: 英伟达与主权基金的合作以及企业 AI 应用的强劲采用继续支撑芯片设计商。尽管期货分化，云计算基础设施需求依然强劲。

macroRisk.en: No - AI sector strength is driven by earnings and product cycles, not directly correlated with macroeconomic conditions.
macroRisk.zh: 否——AI 板块的强劲表现由盈利和产品周期驱动，与宏观经济条件没有直接关联。

title.en: DXY Weakens on Fed Rate Cut Bets
title.zh: 美元走弱：市场对美联储降息押注升温

impact.en: Dollar index under pressure as markets price in earlier-than-expected rate cuts. Multinational tech beneficiaries from weak USD see headwinds, while EM-linked names benefit.
impact.zh: 美元指数承压，因为市场将早于预期的降息纳入定价。美元疲软对受益于美元的跨国科技股构成阻力，而对与新兴市场相关的公司有利。

macroRisk.en: No - Dollar weakness aligns with dovish Fed stance, which is positive for equity valuations but creates mixed currency translation effects.
macroRisk.zh: 否——美元走弱符合美联储鸽派立场，对股票估值有利，但也带来混杂的货币折算效应。

title.en: Treasury Yields Steady Ahead of PPI Release
title.zh: 美债收益率平稳：等待 PPI 数据发布

impact.en: 10Y yield hovers near key levels as traders await upcoming inflation data. Yield stability supports risk assets, but any spike could trigger broad corrections.
impact.zh: 10年期美债收益率在关键水平附近徘徊，交易员等待即将发布的通胀数据。收益率稳定支撑风险资产，但任何飙升都可能引发广泛回调。

macroRisk.en: Medium - Yield movements directly impact duration-sensitive sectors like real estate and utilities, while tech earnings multiples face compression risk.
macroRisk.zh: 中等——收益率变动直接影响房地产和公用事业等久期敏感板块，同时科技股盈利倍数面临压缩风险。

title.en: Energy Sector Outperforms on Supply Concerns
title.zh: 能源板块表现出色：供应担忧推动

impact.en: Oil supply constraints and geopolitical risks drive prices higher. Energy companies with hedged production see improved margins, but high valuations remain a vulnerability.
impact.zh: 石油供应限制和地缘政治风险推升价格。拥有对冲生产的能源公司看到利润率改善，但高估值仍然是弱点。

macroRisk.en: Medium - Higher oil prices may eventually trigger demand destruction or inflationary feedback loops that complicate Fed policy.
macroRisk.zh: 中等——油价上涨最终可能触发需求破坏或通胀反馈循环，使美联储政策复杂化。

title.zh: 电动车板块面临混合信号

impact.en: EV sales data shows resilient demand despite high interest rates. China competition and tariff issues remain headwinds, but battery cost reductions help.
impact.zh: 电动车销售数据显示，尽管利率高企，需求依然强劲。中国竞争和关税问题仍然是阻力，但电池成本降低提供了帮助。

macroRisk.en: Medium - EV demand is rate-sensitive; higher-for-longer rates could suppress consumer spending on capital-intensive purchases.
macroRisk.zh: 中等——电动车需求对利率敏感；更长期的更高利率可能抑制消费者对资本密集型购买支出。

impact.en: Gold and silver rally on safe-haven demand and real rate declines. Central bank buying continues to provide floor, but high prices could trigger profit-taking.
impact.zh: 黄金和白银在避险需求和实际利率下降的推动下上涨。央行购买继续提供支持，但高价格可能触发获利了结。

macroRisk.en: No - Precious metals act as portfolio insurance rather than macro-risk drivers in isolation.
macroRisk.zh: 否——贵金属作为投资组合保险发挥作用，而非孤立的宏观风险驱动因素。

impact.en: Rotations between defensive and growth sectors continue. Mid-caps lag leaders but show improving technicals ahead of earnings season.
impact.zh: 防御性板块和成长板块之间的轮动持续进行。中小盘股落后于领先企业，但在财报季前显示出改善的技术面。

macroRisk.en: Low - Breadth improvements signal broad participation rather than single-sector concentration risks.
macroRisk.zh: 低——广度改善表明广泛参与，而非单一板块集中风险。

ai.en: AI chipmakers and cloud infrastructure stocks continue to lead, supported by easing inflation data. NVIDIA partnerships with sovereign funds provide tailwind.
ai.zh: AI 芯片制造商和云计算基础设施股票继续领先，得到缓解的通胀数据支持。英伟达与主权基金的合作提供顺风助力。

semiconductor.en: Semiconductor equipment providers see demand from AI-driven fab capex cycles. TSMC production capacity expansions offset China headwinds for domestic names.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体设备供应商受益于 AI 驱动的晶圆厂资本支出周期需求。台积电产能扩张抵消了对国内股票的中国的阻力。

bigTech.en: Magnificent Seven outperform as earnings remain solid but priced in ahead of next quarter's print. Cloud adoption remains resilient across enterprise clients.
bigTech.zh: 七巨头表现优异，盈利保持稳健但在下一季度发布前已被定价。云计算采用在企业客户中保持韧性。

energy.en: Energy sector benefits from geopolitical tensions and supply constraints driving prices higher. Hedged producers see margin expansion opportunities.
energy.zh: 能源板块受益于地缘政治紧张局势和供应限制推升价格。对冲生产商看到利润率扩张机会。

ev.en: EV demand remains resilient despite high rates, but China competition and tariffs create uncertainty. Battery cost reductions help offset some headwinds.
ev.zh: 电动车需求尽管利率高企依然保持韧性，但中国竞争和关税造成不确定性。电池成本降低帮助抵消部分阻力。

market.en: Futures trade mixed with S&P 500 testing record levels. Breadth remains healthy but sector divergences persist between growth and value.
market.zh: 期货分化，标普 500 测试历史高位。广度保持健康，但成长和价值板块之间的分歧持续存在。

preciousMetals.en: Gold and silver at multi-year highs on safe-haven flows, real rate declines, and central bank buying. High prices may trigger profit-taking but demand remains.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金和白银创多年新高，受避险资金流向、实际利率下降和央行购买推动。高价格可能触发获利了结，但需求依然存在。

oil.en: Crude oil climbs amid Iran-Hormuz tensions and OPEC+ production discipline. WTI testing key resistance levels; sustained break could push toward next supply ceiling.
oil.zh: 原油在中伊紧张局势和欧佩克+生产纪律下上涨。WTI 测试关键阻力位，持续突破可能推动至下一个供应天花板。

futures.en: S&P 500 futures mixed/flat, Nasdaq slightly bullish on AI strength. Dow vulnerable to oil price volatility.
futures.zh: 标普 500 期货分化/持平，纳斯达克因 AI 强势略偏乐观。道指易受油价波动影响。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y Treasury yield hovering near 4.0-4.1%, awaiting PPI data for direction. Stability supports equities but spikes are dangerous.
treasury10Y.zh: 10年期美债收益率在 4.0%-4.1%附近徘徊，等待 PPI 数据指明方向。稳定支撑股票，但飙升危险。

dxy.en: DXY under pressure as markets price in Fed rate cuts earlier than expected. Weak dollar benefits multinationals and commodity exporters.
dxy.zh: 美元指数承压，因为市场将早于预期的美联储降息纳入定价。弱势美元利好跨国企业和大宗商品出口商。

oil.en: WTI oil trading elevated near multi-week highs on geopolitical tensions around Iran-Hormuz Strait. Sustained strength could spark inflation concerns.
oil.zh: WTI 油价在近几周高位的附近交易，伊朗-霍尔木兹海峡的地缘政治紧张局势推升。持续强势可能引发通胀担忧。

keyRisk.en: PPI release later this week and any unexpected yield spike or oil surge that re-ignites inflation expectations for the Fed.
keyRisk.zh: 本周稍后发布的 PPI 数据，以及任何意外的美债收益率飙升或油价上涨，可能会重燃市场对美联储通胀预期的担忧。

note.en: Mixed sentiment due to oil-driven inflation concerns versus AI earnings strength. PPI data will be critical for Fed pivot timing and direction.
note.zh: 混合情绪：油价驱动的通胀担忧与 AI 盈利强劲之间的博弈。PPI 数据对美联储转向时机和方向至关重要。
